address: London Road, Dunton Green Sevenoaks, Kent,TN13 2TD
bio: Enjoy a traditional Afternoon Tea at Donnington Manor Hotel. This 15th-century manor house has beautifully manicured gardens leading to a welcoming and pristinely presented Tudor property, offering style and excellent service.  Donnington Manor Hotel is a fusion of classic British heritage and contemporary style, elegantly offset with touches of European flair inside the restaurant. The walls and gardens are peppered with artwork, and there is careful attention to detail with a personalised approach to hospitality.  Afternoon Tea includes a selection of elegant finger sandwiches with an assortment of fillings, unsurpassable scones served with jam and clotted cream, and delicious freshly baked cakes and petit fours. These are served alongside a choice of organic teas, or why not upgrade with a glass of Bottega Gold Prosecco?  Donnington Manor is just 10 minutes from Sevenoaks and a 30 minute drive from London. Dunton Green Station is just a short distance away
